d: Elon Musk is distancing himself from MAGA after spending hundreds of millions of dollars backing Donald Trump and Republican candidates. Following the Democrats’ sweeping victories in the 2026 midterm elections, the billionaire says he feels 'pretty foolish' about his political spending and admits he would have spent less. Once one of Trump’s closest allies and the face of DOGE, Musk could now face greater scrutiny from a Democratic-controlled Congress. In Texas, allegations surrounding SpaceX’s access to rural broadband grants have also drawn political attention. Is Musk abandoning MAGA,…
